about: A recorded terminal session of Claude Code in the workbench: the hook calls and the tool calls of one turn, in their order. The fake agent (fakeAgent.ts) plays them against the host routes. ${checkout} is the checkout and ${scratch} the scratch file of the run.

payload.prompt: The hat lifts off the head at 6 s. Look at the top view and fix it.

steps.content: A scratch file of the workbench end-to-end test. The undo of the turn deletes it.
